claim: Control Tower detects drift automatically; drift for a member account is surfaced in Amazon SNS notifications that are aggregated in the audit account, but these SNS notifications are not available when the auto-enroll capability for accounts is enabled.

qualifiers.condition: the SNS drift notifications are not available when auto-enroll is enabled

evidence.quote: AWS Control Tower detects drift automatically.
Drift for a member account is surfaced in the Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notifications that are aggregated in the audit account.
When the auto-enroll capability for accounts is enabled in **Settings**, these SNS notifications are not available.
